rules.statement: Section 402 of the Civil Procedure Code does not apply to cases where the Fiscal has been unable to serve summons on a defendant for a considerable period, but rather applies to cases where the defendant appears and subsequently fails to prosecute the action.
rules.supporting_quote: "Now, can it be said that the Court was justified, in the circumstances, assuming that it had the power of its own motion to order the action to abate, to make such an order on the ground that the plaintiff had not taken the necessary steps to prosecute the action?"
